name: EPIC 246314082
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 11.5 solar radii and 0.72 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,936 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.72 solar masses and 11.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,003 K at its surface.
